evidence.detail: The exact v308 class-reference scan finds rs/l/f/a/g/b consumed externally only by rs/n/c/d/d. That handler carries the exact literal 'raids' and owns the adjacent already-reviewed RaidPartyOverlay and RaidTheatreBar components, independently fixing the subsystem as raids.
Its two-integer update method stores current and total values, computes current / total * 100.0, and formats the centered display as 'current / total @yel@(percent%)'.
The draw path renders a fixed 500 x 18 bar, computes the filled width as ceil(500 * (percent / 100)), draws background and filled regions, then centers the current/total/percent text over the bar.

In rs/n/c/d/d, operation 15 registers this component alongside the raid theatre bar, while operation 17 reads two integers and calls its current/total update method before applying its boolean color/style mode.
